Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying questions from our security intake team before we schedule the deep-dive:

- Do you support OIDC for SSO, or is SAML the primary/only option? We prefer OIDC but can accommodate SAML if needed.
- Can you provide a SCIM provisioning API spec (endpoints, auth, rate limits) — if you have an OpenAPI/YAML that’s ideal.

- Are there any separate admin roles (super-admin, org-admin, billing) and can role assignments be restricted by group via SCIM?

We’ll attach our vendor questionnaire to this thread after an internal pass. If you can point us to an intake/HubSpot link (if you use one) that would be helpful for tracking.

Hi Elena — thanks for the questions. Quick answers below and attaching the SCIM spec + admin logs README for detail.

- SSO protocols: we support both SAML 2.0 and OIDC. If you prefer OIDC we can provide example client configs and metadata.
- SCIM: See attached scim_api_spec_v1.yaml — endpoints include /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups, token-based auth (OAuth bearer) with a default rate limit of 100 reqs/min per org.
- Audit logs: admin action logs retained for 365 days by default. We can produce exports in JSON/CSV for requested ranges; exports are delivered via a secure S3 link.
- RBAC: built-in roles include super-admin, org-admin, admin, auditor, and user. Group-based role assignment is supported via SCIM groups; we can map SCIM group membership to Redwood roles during provisioning.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll populate your vendor questionnaire — please attach when ready or point me at the intake link.
2) Schedule a 45-min tech deep-dive on Fri (July 23) to walk SCIM flows and admin export. I’m available 9–12 PT that day.
3) If you need a formal evidence package (config screenshots, policy excerpts), we can assemble and deliver within 2 business days after the call.

Attaching: scim_api_spec_v1.yaml (stub), admin_logs_export_readme.md (stub)
